# Socket.IO browser client

Vendored Socket.IO client **4.8.1**, served locally so student browsers do not
contact a third-party CDN at runtime. No Node build step is required.

- Source: https://cdn.socket.io/4.8.1/socket.io.min.js
- License source: https://unpkg.com/socket.io-client@4.8.1/LICENSE
- License: MIT, retained in `socket.io-LICENSE.txt` and the distribution header.
- SHA-256 of the unmodified JavaScript:
  `b0e735814f8dcfecd6cdb8a7ce95a297a7e1e5f2727a29e6f5901801d52fa0c5`

This 4.x browser client uses the Socket.IO/Engine.IO protocol supported by the
repository's Flask-SocketIO 5.x / python-socketio 5.x dependencies.
